newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Plasson seeks London listing.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Plasson seeks London listing.

text.p: Kibbutz-based Plasson will soon become the first Israeli company with a full listing on the London Stock Exchange, said Roger Hornett of Societe Generale Strauss Turnbull Securities (SGST).
The world's leading manufacturer of plastic pipe connectors, Plasson plans to issue 12.5 million shares and raise about 20 million sterling. Impact day is October 3, Hornett said.
SGST is acting as sponsor and distributor for the offering.

Last year Plasson had sales of 52.4 million sterling, on which it earned 4.4 million sterling, for a net margin of 8.4 percent after tax. In the first half of 1996 it had sales of 28 million sterling, earnings of 2.9 million and a 35 percent annualised rate of growth.
Hornett said 85 pct of the company's sales are in exports, 70 percent of which are in Europe. Germany is its main market with 24 percent.

"The offering is priced not only to reflect underlying asset value but also the fact that it is the first Israeli stock to receive a full listing on the stock exchange in London. It will be priced at a discount to U.K. competition with a yield premium," Hornett said.

While nearly 100 Israeli securities are listed in the United States, London is a new venue for Israeli companies. Several have recently started to trade on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
Hornett said Plasson chose London because in terms of sales ..."it is very much a European company".

Its U.K. sales doubled in 1995 and by end of this year it will have a U.K. market share in excess of 30 percent. "They have just launched a new product in the U.K. which should have very rapid growth. By listing on the U.K. market this gives them a higher profile and is seen as a very important factor by the companies in Britain with which they do business, such as the gas and water utilities," Hornett said.
He noted the AIM market was more suited to companies which do not yet have a proven profit record.
